heroHeadline: Canada Wildfire Season Winds Down: 208 Active Fires, Preparedness Level 2 as Final National Report Issued
heroSubtitle: CIFFC’s last national situation report of 2026 (as of Sep 30) lists 208 active fires nationally — 14 out of control — with 5,422 fires and 4,488,065 hectares burned year to date, about average for the 10-year period. All international resources have demobilized and no domestic resource requests are outstanding. In BC, the Mount Jack and Bald Range fires are listed as under control.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
